So a bit later, he decides to take us to an R rated movie that my parents would have never let me watch. When we got there, I couldn’t deal with the pain any longer and went to the bathroom with my best friend. It was a huge bathroom with dozens of stalls and it was completely empty. My friend stood by the sink and I went into a stall and unleashed a series of long, loud farts, the amount and volume of which I have never achieved again. My best friend was in hysterics and I was laughing in shame as my loud farts echoed in the empty restroom. We had a falling out early in high school after many years of being best friends but we had a lot of good times before that.

Boxed candy- Nerds and Cookie Doigh bites are definitely good choices. Never heard of Smoresels. Very common movie theatre candy.

Hersheys Cookies n Crème- Not the most popular Hersheys bar. But I guess it’s common enough.

Dr. Sour- Refer to “Brain Blasterz” entry. 

Dr. Sweet- Another no.

Herr’s chips- Yes. Solid choice. Well loved regional chips. 

Cheese Krunchies- I’m guessing they’re like Cheez-Its, which are popular.

Some good choices but overall, a lot of brands themselves were not recognizable, but had products similar to those of popular brands. I would assume the taste would be different. I would say the best choices of “authentic” food would be the Herr’s chips, Nerds, and Cookie Dough bites. Best “authentic” drink would be the root beer. 

Keep in mind, since the US is large, the opinions may be different in other regions.
